description: Summarise your own shipping history: how many bookings, what you spent, and the split by mode, status and lane over a window. Both the headline count and every breakdown are computed from ONE population — your bookings via the agent API (warp-site /bookings) — so the total always matches the splits. Auth required.

group_by.description: Which breakdown to lead with. All three are returned regardless; this only orders the response.

limit.description: How many of your most recent bookings to summarise (default 100, max 500)

name: analytics
title: Summarise Shipping History
